_comment: Browser extension IDs allowed to start the native host com.eid.download. Read by scripts/windows/native_host_manifests.py when the Windows installer is built (crates/eid-gui/installer/README.md). chrome/edge: the id pinned by the public key in scripts/ext/build.mjs (CHROME_KEY), used by the unpacked/sideloaded build in Chrome and Edge. firefox: the gecko id in the same file. Store listings (Chrome Web Store, Edge Add-ons) get their own ids: add them here when they exist (docs/OWNER-ACTIONS.md). An empty list means that browser is not registered.
